title: Severe waterlogging at Andheri subway after 3 hours of heavy rain
summary: Andheri subway flooded completely. Traffic diverted to Western Express Highway. Local trains running late by 20-30 mins.
full_description: Continuous heavy rainfall for 3 hours caused severe waterlogging at Andheri subway, one of Mumbai's busiest traffic corridors. Water level reached 4 feet, making the underpass completely impassable. BMC deployed pumps but water removal is slow due to high tide at Mahim Creek. Commuters reported 90-minute delays. No injuries reported but 2 buses got stuck. Local train services between Andheri and Vile Parle are running on slow track only. IMD predicts more rain in next 6 hours.

sources.snippet: Waterlogging at Andheri subway after 3 hours of rain, traffic diverted

ai_analysis.risk_summary: Urban flooding in low-lying areas, high tide worsening drainage
ai_analysis.recommended_action: Avoid Andheri subway, use Jogeshwari-Vikhroli Link Road

title: Chemical factory fire in Thane MIDC area spreading rapidly
summary: Major fire at chemical storage unit in Thane. Toxic smoke rising. 8 fire engines fighting blaze. Avoid Ghodbunder Road.
full_description: Fire broke out at 6:15 AM at Apex Chemicals in Thane MIDC area near Mumbai border. The fire started in a solvent storage tank and spread to adjacent units. Thick black smoke visible from Ghodbunder Road up to Borivali. 8 fire engines and 3 water tankers deployed. Two firefighters suffered smoke inhalation.

sources.snippet: Chemical factory blaze in Thane MIDC

ai_analysis.risk_summary: Toxic smoke hazard, potential for explosion in nearby cylinders
ai_analysis.recommended_action: Close windows, avoid Thane-Mumbai corridor, wear N95 masks outdoors

title: Old building collapse in Thane West, 15 feared trapped
summary: G+3 residential building collapsed in Rabodi area. NDRF and Fire Brigade on site. Rescue operations in progress.
full_description: A 40-year-old residential building, 'Sai Prasad', collapsed today at 11:30 AM in the Rabodi area of Thane West. Preliminary reports suggest 15 residents are trapped under the debris. 4 fire engines and a specialized NDRF rescue team from Mumbai have reached the spot. 5 people have been rescued so far and sent to Thane Civil Hospital.

sources.snippet: Building collapse in Thane Rabodi, rescue ops ongoing

ai_analysis.recommended_action: Avoid the Rabodi area. Clear paths for ambulances.

title: Major Landslide on Mumbai-Pune Expressway near Lonavala
summary: Debris blocking all lanes towards Mumbai. Traffic diverted to Old Highway.
full_description: A massive landslide occurred at the Khandala ghat section of the Mumbai-Pune Expressway. Huge boulders and mud have blocked Mumbai-bound lanes. Highway Police have diverted all traffic to the Old Mumbai-Pune Highway.

ai_analysis.risk_summary: Potential for further slides due to rain
ai_analysis.recommended_action: Postpone non-essential travel between Mumbai and Pune.

title: Gas Leak reported in Navi Mumbai Industrial Area (Taloja)
summary: Foul smell reported across Taloja and Kharghar. Fire brigade investigating. Residents advised to stay indoors.
full_description: A suspected ammonia gas leak from an industrial unit in Taloja MIDC has caused panic. Air quality monitoring is active.

sources.snippet: Fire brigade responding to gas leak reports

title: Cyclone Warning: Deep Depression in Arabian Sea approaching Palghar
summary: IMD issues Red Alert for Palghar. Wind speeds of 90kmph expected.
full_description: The IMD has upgraded the weather system to a 'Severe Deep Depression'. Red Alert has been issued for Palghar district.

ai_analysis.recommended_action: Stay away from the coast. Secure loose objects.

title: Bridge crack discovered on Ghatkopar-Mankhurd link road
summary: Structural crack found on bridge. Bridge closed for heavy vehicles.
full_description: BMC engineers discovered a 2-inch wide structural crack on the bridge connecting Ghatkopar to Mankhurd.

ai_analysis.risk_summary: Structural failure risk for heavy vehicles
ai_analysis.recommended_action: Avoid bridge if driving truck or bus.

title: Water contamination in Malad East - 50 people sick
summary: 50 residents hospitalized with gastroenteritis. Water contamination suspected.
full_description: Residents of Malad East were hospitalized with vomiting and diarrhea. BMC suspects contamination of municipal water supply.

ai_analysis.recommended_action: Boil water before drinking in Malad East.

title: Fire at high-rise in Borivali West - 12 floors affected
summary: Major fire in 20-story building. 5 rescued via ladders. Electrical short circuit suspected.
full_description: Fire broke out on the 8th floor of Siddharth Heights in Borivali West. The fire spread through the duct to multiple floors.

ai_analysis.recommended_action: Avoid Borivali West. Clear path for fire engines.

title: Building wall collapse in Kurla due to metro excavation
summary: Compound wall collapsed in Kurla East. MMRDA halts work.
full_description: A 30-foot compound wall of Shanti Niwas building in Kurla (East) collapsed during metro line 4 excavation.

ai_analysis.risk_summary: Potential foundation risk to adjacent structures
ai_analysis.recommended_action: Residents should report any new cracks immediately.
